jhertzli@ix.netcom.com (Joseph Hertzlinger) wolfed
down a pork sausage and asked:
>
>BTW, you have often criticized PC'ers. What is the criterion for being
>a PC'er?

TK's definition of leftism is a pretty good 
operational definition for the "PC'er" as 
well.  As I use them in this forum, the terms 
arn essentially synonymous.

"229. ... Maybe the best diagnostic trait of the 
leftist is his tendency to sympathize with the 
following movements: feminism, gay rights, ethnic 
rights, disability rights, animal rights, [and] 
political correctness. Anyone who strongly 
sympathizes with ALL of these movements is almost 
certainly a leftist. [36]"

Cheers,
99
